summary.name: Gayatri Sharma Kurmatey
summary.headline: Data Engineer and AI/ML Engineer
summary.overview: Gayatri has 6+ years of experience building data pipelines, automation systems, executive dashboards, and machine learning workflows across automotive, energy, education, logistics, supply chain, and research domains.
summary.working_style: She has experience as a zero-to-one employee, not only building zero-to-one features, and works across technical, business, and operational teams.

experience.details: Led data engineering, ERP workflow design, automation, and reporting across supply chain, HR, inventory, purchasing, and demand planning. Built Python ETL pipelines, PostgreSQL data models, and operational reporting workflows. Also built the public Belong Automotive website.
Worked on HR data integration, dashboard adoption, RBAC automation, and Azure-based compliance workflows. Connected MSSQL, APIs, Tableau, and Power BI data.

Built SQL, Azure Synapse, and Power Platform pipelines for student database migration, asset workflows, access-control dashboards, and district reporting. Automated reporting and supported Power BI, Tableau, and Power Platform adoption.
Developed and optimized Spark SQL, Tableau, Power BI, and Python reporting workflows for operational analytics, dashboard refresh performance, and recurring reporting automation.
Built Power BI, Tableau, Power Platform, and Dynamics 365 solutions for space planning, people analytics, CAPEX visibility, and forecasting, including executive-level portfolio monitoring.
Developed computer vision and deep learning workflows using OpenCV and Mask R-CNN for floor plan object detection, image annotation, dataset validation, and semantic segmentation.
Analyzed last-mile logistics, delivery performance, customer feedback, pilot operations, onboarding workflows, and escalation patterns.
Built procurement analytics and internal workflow systems using Sybase, MySQL, SQLdbx, HTML, CSS, and Java for query visualization, procurement analysis, and booking automation.
Worked on graph-based machine learning for protein structure representation using BioPython parsing, NetworkX graphs, Graph2Vec embeddings, clustering, and geometry-aware deep learning exploration.
Supported research involving Generative AI, LLMs, BERT, Haystack, semantic modeling, knowledge extraction, and advanced research analytics.

projects.name: VoltX
projects.description: A full-stack EV charging intelligence platform built on the Tesla Fleet API Developer platform. It retrieves vehicle state and nearby Superchargers, applies geospatial logic, and sends proactive browser and mobile alerts.

projects.name: AI Portfolio
projects.description: An interactive portfolio designed as a recruiter-facing data and AI/ML experience. It combines a responsive visual system, an AI assistant grounded in portfolio data, and a secure serverless backend.
implemented: Responsive portfolio design with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript

projects.name: Belong Automotive website
projects.description: Gayatri built the live public website for Belong Automotive and connected website strategy with SEO, analytics, conversion tracking, and content considerations.

research.details: Tested graph-based ML for protein structure clustering with BioPython, NetworkX, Graph2Vec, Weisfeiler-Lehman labeling, PCA, t-SNE, and KMeans.
Compiled Generative AI, LLM, BERT, and Haystack approaches for semantic modeling, knowledge extraction, and research analytics.
Built Dockerized Open Data Cube workflows for NASA satellite image ingestion and tested ML models for road accident severity prediction.
